Module 205                                                                                                                                                      Neuroanatomy 
2 | P a g e 
 
 
Spinal cord 
1- In adults, the spinal cord ends at: (2019 - 2020). 
a- Lower border of L1. 
b- Lower border of L3. 
c- Lower border of S1. 
d- Lower border of L3. 
2- A patient came to emergency room presenting with headache; fever, nausea and 
stiffness of the neck. He was diagnosed as meningitis. What is the name of the procedure by which 
a special needle is inserted into the subarachnoid space to get sample of CSF to confirm the 
diagnosis? (2018 – 2017 - 2016). 
a- Conus medullaris. 
b- Lumbar cistern. 
c- Lumbar puncture. 
d- Cauda equine. 
3- Cauda equina is: (2018). 
a- The lower segments of the spinal cord. 
b- The roots of lower lumbar, sacral and coccygeal nerves. 
c- The spinal nerves of the conus medullaris. 
d- The spinal nerves of the lower lumbar and sacral segments. 
4- The spinal cord has ...... select the best statement (DEP BOOK). 
a- An outer covering of gray matter and an inner core of white matter. 
b- Anterior and posterior roots of a single spinal nerve attached to a single segment. 
c- Cells in the posterior gray horn give rise to efferent fibers that supply skeletal muscle. 
d- A central canal that is situated in the white commissure. 
5- If we need to insert a needle into the subarachnoid space to sample CSF, where is a relatively 
safe point for needle insertion? (DEP BOOK). 
a- Between C-7 and T-1. 
b- Between L-3 and L-4. 
c- Between L-1 and L-2. 
d- Between T-12 and L-1. 
6- In newborns, conus medullaris lies opposite the: (2021 – IPKA - 2023). 
a- 10th thoracic vertebra. 
b- 1st lumbar vertebra. 
c- 3rd lumbar vertebra. 
d- 5th lumbar vertebra.

Module 205                                                                                                                                                      Neuroanatomy 
3 | P a g e 
 
7- One of the following arteries is not supplying spinal cord: (2021). 
a- Radicular branches of vertebral artery. 
b- Posterior spinal artery. 
c- Medial spinal artery. 
d- Anterior spinal artery. 
8- The true statement about the spinal cord is: (2020  - 2019). 
a- The spinal dura end at the level of S4. 
b- It has four enlargements. 
c- The filum terminal is a fold of pia below the termination of spinal cord attached to the. coccyx. 
d- The largest radicular artery is that of S2. 
9- Cauda equine, choose one true statement: (2020). 
a- Formed of all thoracic and lumber nerves. 
b- Occupy lower part of spinal canal. 
c- Surrounded by the three layers of the meninges. 
d- Pass through the sacrum to end at S2. 
10- The lower end of spinal cord is called: (2019). 
a- Cauda equina. 
b- Denticulate ligament. 
c- Conus medullaris. 
d- Ganglion impar. 
11- Filum terminal is attached to: (IPKA). 
a- S3. 
b- S4. 
c- Foramen magnum. 
d- Back of coccyx. 
12- Lumbar puncture can be done safely: (IPKA). 
a- Between L1 and L2 vertebrae. 
b- Between L3 and L4 vertebrae. 
c- Between S3 and S4 vertebrae. 
d- Between T3 and T4 vertebrae. 
13- Anterior spinal artery supplies: (IPKA). 
a- Posterior 2/3 of spinal cord. 
b- Lateral 2/3 of spinal cord. 
c- Posterior 1/3 of spinal cord. 
d- Anterior 2/3 of spinal cord.

Module 205                                                                                                                                                      Neuroanatomy 
4 | P a g e 
 
14- Regarding the spinal cord, select the true statement: (2023). 
a- The lumbosacral enlargement called conus medullaris. 
b- Denticulate ligament are lateral extension of arachnoid. 
c- The adult spinal cord terminates at intervertebral disc between L2 and L3. 
d- The filum terminale attach the lower end of spinal cord with the back of coccyx. 
15- The arterial supply of the lumber enlargement of the spinal cord: (2024). 
a- The arteria radicularis magna. 
b- The anterior spinal artery. 
c- The posterior spinal arteries. 
d- The basilar artery. 
16- Concerning spinal nerve C-8, which of the following is true? (DEP BOOK). 
a- C-8 enters/exits between vertebrae C6 and C7. 
b- C-8 enters/exits between vertebrae C7 and C8. 
c- C-8 enters/exits between vertebrae C7 and C8. 
d- C-8 enters/exits between vertebrae C7 and T1. 
17- In adults, the spinal cord normally ends at: (DEP BOOK). 
a- Lower border of L1. 
b- Lower border of L3. 
c- Lower border of S1. 
d- Lower border of L5. 
18- Regarding the spinal meninges, one of the following is true: (DEP BOOK). 
a- The spinal arachnoid matter ends at the level of L2. 
b- The spinal arteries lie in the epidural space. 
c- The lower part of the spinal dura forms a sheath around the filum terminale. 
d- The lumbar cistern extends from L1 to S3. 
19- Regarding the blood supply of the spinal cord, one of the following is true: (DEP BOOK). 
a- The posterior spinal artery supplies the anterior and lateral funiculi of the white matter. 
b- The arteria radicularis magna supplies the cervical enlargement. 
c- The internal vertebral venous plexus lies in the subdural space. 
d- The thoracic region of the spinal cord is more liable. 
20- Regarding the meninges of the spinal cord, one of the following is true: (DEP BOOK). 
a- The dura mater ends at the level of the third piece of sacrum. 
b- The arachnoid mater ends at the level of the forth piece of sacrum. 
c- The pia mater forms ligamentum denticulatum. 
d- The subdural space contains the vertebral venous plexuses.

Module 205                                                                                                                                                      Neuroanatomy 
5 | P a g e 
 
21- Regarding the spinal cord, one of the following is true: (DEP BOOK). 
a- The spinal dura ends at the level of S4. 
b- It is drained by spinal and vertebral venous plexuses. 
c- It has three enlargements. 
d- The largest radicular artery is that of S2. 
22- The lower end of spinal cord is called: (DEP BOOK). 
a- Cauda equina. 
b- Denticulate ligament. 
c- Conus medullaris. 
d- Ganglion ispar. 
23- Substantia gelatinosa of Rolandi forms the second order neurons in the pathway of: (DEP BOOK). 
a- Pain only. 
b- Temperature only. 
c- Pain and temperature. 
d- Simple touch. 
24- The posterior funiculus of the spinal cord contains: (DEP BOOK). 
a- Long descending fibers. 
b- Long ascending fibers. 
c- Both long ascending and descending fibers. 
d- Associative fibers. 
25- Regarding the pyramidal tract choose the correct answer: (DEP BOOK). 
a- Consists of many neurons. 
b- It arises only from the pyramidal cells of area 4 of the cerebral cortex. 
c- About 15 % of its fibers normally form the pyramidal decussation. 
d- It has a corticospinal and corticonuclear parts. 
26- Regarding Brown Sequard syndrome; choose one best answer: (DEP BOOK). 
a- It is associated with loss of reflexes at the level of the lesion. 
b- It is usually associated with injury to nerve roots entering the segments below the lesion. 
c- There is pyramidal tract lesion on the opposite side and proprioceptive lesion on the same side. 
d- It is associated with loss of reflexes below the lesion. 
27- Regarding the blood supply to the spinal cord, select the correct statement: (DEP BOOK). 
a- Anterior 2/3 of the spinal cord is supplied by the posterior spinal arteries. 
b- Anterior spinal arteries are reinforced in the cervical region by branches from the vertebral arteries. 
c- There are two anterior spinal arteries. 
d- The cervical region of the spinal cord is predisposed to vascular insufficiency.

Module 205                                                                                                                                                      Neuroanatomy 
6 | P a g e 
 
28- Regarding the spinal meninges select the correct statement: (DEP BOOK). 
a- The denticulate ligament attaches pia to the arachnoid mater. 
b- The pia mater is attached to the foramen magnum. 
c- The arachnoid mater ends at L2 level. 
d- The dura mater sends sheaths around the spinal nerve roots. 
29- Regarding the spinal meninges, select the true statement: (2019). 
a- The denticulate ligaments are thickening of the dura mater. 
b- The dura mater continues below as the film terminale. 
c-The pia matter is closely adherent to the spinal cord. 
d- The dura mater ends at the level of the fourth sacral vertebra. 
30- In performing a lumbar puncture for CSF collection, the needle Is Inserted Into: (2021 – 2023 - IPKA). 
a- Subdural space. 
b- Epidural space. 
c- Subarachnoid space. 
d- Extradural space. 
 
Brain stem 
1- The pyramidal tract lies in the midbrain in one of the following parts: (2018). 
a- Medial 1/5 of crus cerebri. 
b- Lateral 1/5 of crus cerebri. 
c- Intermediate of 3/5 of crus cerebri. 
d- Dorsal to crus cerebri. 
2- A 50-year-old patient came to outpatient clinic. On examination, the physician found that there 
was a hemiplegia on the left side and medial squint on the right side. What are structures most 
likely affected? (2018). 
a- Left pyramidal tract and left abducent nerve. 
b- Right pyramidal tract and right abducent nerve. 
c- Left pyramidal tract and left oculomotor nerve. 
d- Right pyramidal tract and right oculomotor nerve. 
3- The medial medullary syndrome (Dejerine syndrome) is characterized by: (2018). 
a- Ipsilateral hemiplegia and hypoglossal paralysis. 
b- Ipsilateral hemiplegia with contralateral hypoglossal paralysis. 
c- Ipsilateral hypoglossal paralysis with contralateral hemiplegia. 
d- Contralateral hemiplegia and hypoglossal paralysis. 
4- Patient came to ER with LMNL of the hypoglossal nerve on the right side and UMNL hemiplegia 
on the left side. Where is the site of the lesion? (2017). 
a- Motor area 4. 
b- Midbrain. 
c- Pons. 
d- Medulla oblongata.

5- The pyramidal tract fibers supply the following cranial nerve nucleus: (2017). 
a- Olfactory. 
b- Optic. 
c- Trigeminal. 
d- Vestibulocochlear. 
6- The following artery shares in the supply of the medulla: (2016). 
a- Posterior inferior cerebellar. 
b- Superior cerebellar. 
c- Posterior cerebral. 
d- Middle cerebral. 
7- Which of the following cranial nerves exits the posterior aspect of the brainstem? One of the 
following cranial nerves is attached to the posterior aspect of the brain stem: (DEP BOOK - 2024). 
a- Abducens (VI). 
b- Hypoglossal (XII). 
c- Trigeminal (V). 
d-Trochlear (IV). 
e- Oculomotor (III). 
f- Vagus (X). 
8- 50-year-old patient came to outpatient clinic. On examination, the physician found that there 
was a hemiplegia on the left side and medial squint on the right side. What are structures most 
likely affected? (2017). 
a- Left pyramidal tract and left abducent nerve. 
b- Right pyramidal tract and right abducent nerve. 
c- Left pyramidal tract and left oculomotor nerve. 
d- Right pyramidal tract and right oculomotor nerve. 
9- In case of right corticonuclear tract injury above the level of the motor nucleus of. 
facial nerve, which side of the face is affected? (2017). 
a· Upper ½ right side. 
b- Lower ½ right side. 
c- Upper½ left side. 
d- Lower ½ left side. 
10- Facial colliculus overlies (2015). 
a- Abducent nucleus. 
b- Facial motor nucleus. 
c- Hypoglossal nucleus. 
d- Dorsal nucleus of X. 
e- Cochlear nuclei. 
11- Concerning the olive, select the correct statement: (DEP BOOK).
